task_fish_new_desc:
Redesigned fishing feature. In theory, you can now fish indefinitely.
It is still not possible to directly resume overnight fishing sessions that have been interrupted by the monthly pass. You can try setting up a scheduled task to continue fishing, but results are not guaranteed.
The fishing feature only hack-on and uses the mouse for automatically buying bait and selling fish.
The auto-buy bait function purchases bait or switches to universal bait when it detects a shortage (the bait detection threshold is unrelated to this task), and the auto-sell function attempts to sell fish when Fish Scale Coins are low.

task_pukaland_lucky_star_option_start_de: How long to wait after clicking "Start Game" before spamming Space, used to skip the intro animation.
setting_combat_desc: Shared by every task that enters combat (e.g. Auto Combat). The team is fixed: build it according to the scheme notes yourself; the script never checks or changes your team. Before each fight the log lists the scheme, rotation and per-slot combos that will actually run.
setting_combat_scheme_desc:
How to use combos and switch characters (R arc disc, Q ultimate, E skill). Built-in schemes are not tied to specific characters; pressing a skill on cooldown is harmless.

- **Team rotation** (default): each member R → Q → E → 1.5 s of attacks, switching 1→2→3→4
- **Quick swap**: each member only casts R → Q → E, then switches, 1→2→3→4
- **Main DPS**: slot 1 casts R → Q → E, attacks and casts E again; order 1→2→1→3→1→4, supports cast and swap back to slot 1
- **Support first**: slots 2→3→4 apply buffs, then slot 1 bursts (opener: slot 2)
- **Dual DPS**: order 3→1→4→2, supports 3 and 4 between long turns of DPS 1 and 2 (opener: slot 3)
- **Heavy attack**: after skills, light attack + charged heavy attack twice, 1→2→3→4
- **Evasive**: after skills, alternate attacks and dodges three times, 1→2→3→4
- **Solo loop**: no switching; the current character loops R → Q → E → 2 s of attacks
- **Basic attack only**: no switching, no skills
- **Custom scheme**: load a scheme file you wrote

To change the opener, the rotation order or a slot's combo, enable Advanced adjustments under "Characters & rotation".
setting_combat_custom_scheme_desc: Put the scheme file in config/combat/ under the install folder and enter its file name, or enter a full path. See resource/base/combat/examples/custom_example.json and the "Auto Combat" docs for the syntax.
setting_combat_team_size_desc: Number of characters in your team. Slots beyond it are never switched to, which saves the wait on empty slots. If unsure keep 4; an empty slot is skipped after the first failed switch.
setting_combat_strategy_desc: General rules for every scheme, including custom ones. The ultimate is held when no enemy has been seen for over 1 s. All input pauses on menus, the retreat confirmation, black loading screens or failed detection, and resumes only after a new screenshot confirms the fight.
setting_combat_disabled_actions_desc: Checked actions are skipped in combos, for built-in and custom schemes alike, including the same action written as a raw key. Checking "Switch" fights with the current character only; a combo that is skipped entirely becomes basic attacks.
setting_combat_lock_target_desc: Press the middle mouse button once when the fight starts. After the target is lost it re-locks at most once, instead of pressing repeatedly (which can toggle the lock off). Turn this off if the middle button does something else in your game.
setting_combat_search_turn_desc: When no enemy has been seen for over 1 s, turn the camera about 90° right every ~0.6 s, up to 4 times. Each turn is checked on a new screenshot and stops as soon as an enemy or a menu appears. Adds 2 s to the target-lost wait. Only works with the "Desktop - Foreground" controller; the angle depends on in-game sensitivity.
setting_combat_assist_detection_desc: When the enemy health bar is not visible, also check the bar shape, enemy level text and boss level text; any hit keeps the fight going. Turning it off saves text recognition time but stops earlier when enemies are hidden. The level and boss areas are converted from ok-NTE and are not calibrated for every scene.
setting_combat_clear_confirm_desc: Stop attacking and end the fight after no enemy has been seen for this many seconds in a row. The result is "target lost", not a confirmed clear. Time with the HUD hidden, a black screen or failed detection is not counted. Raise it if enemies often leave the screen.
setting_combat_clear_confirm_pattern: Enter a whole number from 1 to 60
setting_combat_input_desc: Changes how densely the script sends input. It is not game speed and does not change cooldowns or animations.
setting_combat_speed_desc: Only scales the default click interval and the minimum time per turn: 2.0 clicks more densely, 0.5 more sparsely (below 1, a short pause is also added after each command). Charge, movement, wait, field time and switch confirmation still use real seconds. 1.0 keeps the original pace.
setting_combat_speed_pattern: Enter a number from 0.5 to 2.0 with at most two decimals
setting_combat_team_desc: Adjust the opener, rotation order, combos and field time per slot. Empty fields keep the selected scheme. Character names are only your labels; the script does not recognize portraits or change your in-game team.
setting_combat_advanced_desc: When on, you can override the rotation mode, opener and order, disable slots, and set each slot's name, combo and field time. Turning it off restores the scheme as is.
setting_combat_rotation_mode_desc: Keep the scheme's mode, or force rotation or staying on field.
setting_combat_rotation_order_desc: Comma-separated slot numbers; the first is the opener and repeats are allowed, e.g. 1,2,1,3 brings the main DPS back each time. Empty keeps the scheme. Disabled slots and slots beyond the team size are removed automatically.
setting_combat_rotation_order_pattern: Enter 1-16 slot numbers from 1 to 4, separated by commas
setting_combat_field_time_desc: Minimum time each character stays on field; a combo that ends early is filled with basic attacks. Empty keeps the scheme; each slot can also set its own.
setting_combat_field_time_pattern: Enter a number from 0 to 10 with at most two decimals
setting_combat_disabled_slots_desc: Checked slots are never switched to and are removed from the rotation order and from switch commands in combos (e.g. empty slots or characters you do not want on field). A rotation scheme needs at least one usable slot, or an error is shown before the fight.
setting_combat_slot_desc: Adjust this slot only; empty fields keep the scheme. Name and note are only used in hints and the pre-fight summary.
setting_combat_slot_combo_desc: Comma-separated commands, e.g. skill, ultimate, l_click(1.5), dodge(s). Same syntax as scheme files. Mistakes are reported with their position before the fight; another combo is never substituted silently.
task_auto_combat_desc: Fights automatically with the scheme set in "Settings → Task settings → Combat" (movement, E, Q, switching, jumping). It reports "victory confirmed" only on clear victory or clear evidence; in the open world, losing the target only means it stopped attacking, not that enemies are cleared. The task ends on retreat, timeout, a long-missing HUD or failed screenshots instead of attacking blindly. Requires the "Desktop - Foreground" controller; build your team according to the scheme first.
task_auto_combat_option_mode_desc: Once: stop after one fight. Continuous: keep watching and fight whenever enemies appear.
task_auto_combat_option_mode_once_desc: Wait for a fight, finish it, then end the task.
task_auto_combat_option_mode_continuous_: Keep watching and fight whenever enemies appear; return to watching after a fight ends or the target is lost. Ends the task on retreat, timeout, HUD problems or errors.
task_auto_combat_option_wait_timeout_des: End the task if no enemy appears within this time. 0 waits forever.
task_auto_combat_option_max_duration_des: End a fight after this long (recorded as a timeout, not a victory). 0 means no limit.
